{{Top|leg}}
A '''tunnel-tube junction station''' was a large box-shaped unit that was primarily used at construction sites on [[Vacuum/Legends|airless]] [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. They were in use until a suitable underground tunnel system could be constructed. It was mounted on a tread system, for mobility, and housed four retractable [[tunnel-tube]]s. The station, with its self-propulsion unit, could be moved into position and the tubes extended to dock with another junction station, [[Starship/Legends|starship]], or the hatch of an erected building . They also contained [[Viewport/Legends|viewports]] and the main control console. The console controlled the propulsion unit and steering controls, also, [[List of phrases and slang/Legends#C|commo]] and safety/alarm circuitry, along with lighting apparatus. [[Artificial gravity generator/Legends|Gravity-control]] systems and [[Life support/Legends|life support]] were also managed from the console. The junction station and tubes sometimes employed a [[Hydroponics/Legends|hydroponics]] recycling system for breathing air, which was tied in to an established hydroponics layout on the site, and metered through the control console.
